root_cause_ui: Vite development server aggressive caching (HMR issue) caused the browser to serve the stale Phase 5.x version of ScanResult.jsx rather than the updated Phase 6.3 component tree.
root_cause_google_domain_age: The WHOIS lookup for google.com returned null for domain_age_days. The frontend ScanResult.jsx was checking 'domainAge === undefined', which evaluated to false for null, leading it to display 'null days' or 'null' instead of the fallback string 'Unavailable'.
known_limitations: External WHOIS provider failures correctly surface as 'Unavailable' in the UI without throwing errors.
